support.title: Support the Developer ☕
support.body: Visita SC is made from brother to brother, 100% free and ad-free, aiming to simplify the circuit overseer's visit routine. If this project has been useful in the circuit and you'd like to express your gratitude, feel free to send voluntary support as a gift. It's a spontaneous gesture of kindness that values the dedication invested in this app.
support.otherWayHint: If you'd like to help in another way, contact me directly via WhatsApp.
support.note: Note: Access remains 100% open and free for everyone, with no limitations.

about.title: About the App
about.body: The goal of this system is to provide an integrated platform for managing the panel's information and reports. Through process automation, the app aims to simplify routines, ensure the integrity of shared data and support activities during the week of the visit to the congregation.
about.developmentBody: System fully designed, structured and programmed independently by
